text:
viv: Quick heads-up before design review  noticed a few confusing edge-cases around pins + badges in the compare table. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/unique/compare-pin-ideas :mag:

omar: What are you seeing?

viv: If you pin a model then collapse rows the pin can disappear under the chevron. Also badge tooltips only show on hover (bad for keyboard).

kelly: Two light options: 1) small persistent pin in the left gutter that survives collapse 2) show a tiny 'Pinned' label next to the name when collapsed 3) a non-intrusive sticky toast/banner when a pin gets hidden by filters. I'm leaning 1+3.

andre: Agree on gutter pin. For the filter case the toast should be dismissible and include action: "Show pinned" to promote pinned rows without changing filters. Keep it non-modal.

viv: Accessibility: badge tooltips need keyboard access and sr-only text in the DOM (not just hover). Also current green badge fails contrast at 12px. We should either darken the token or include an icon + sr-only description.

omar: Microcopy: change tooltip from "Pin version" to "Keep this model visible in compare". For badge tooltip header: "Latency  Cost" and show numbers separated; include units.

kelly: Keyboard interactions: pin should be a button with aria-pressed and accept Space/Enter. Example:

```
<button aria-pressed="false" aria-label="Toggle pin for side-by-side compare">📌</button>
```

Also support pressing "p" while row is focused to toggle.

andre: UX nuance: should pinning auto-scroll the row into view? I prefer no. Show toast: "Pinned model hidden by filters. [Show pinned]" and only scroll when user clicks Show. Avoid jarring motion.

viv: Also add an analytics event pin.toggled {method: click|keyboard|shortcut, visiblePattern: gutter|label|toast}. We'll use it to pick the default after the prototype.

a11y-bot: A11y checklist: - pin control uses aria-pressed + aria-label - badge values present as sr-only text (eg "Latency 23ms; Cost $0.002 per 1k") - tooltips reachable by keyboard focus - contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 or icon/text fallback - hit target >= 32px.

product-ops: Added ACs and created ticket PC-12022: "Compare: persistent pin + filter-reveal toast + badge a11y and copy". Assigned to eng-frontend.

kelly: I'll mock the gutter + toast flow and include keyboard demo. Will post prototype link before the review. If possible, include an RTL sample and a long localized name to test truncation.

omar: One more microcopy ask: toast copy use plain language: "A pinned model is hidden by your filters. Show pinned models? [Show] [Dismiss]". Keep it short.

viv: Thanks all. Prototype incoming and I'll demo Friday. :thumbsup:
